verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents a first-party capability to bulk launch workflows via its REST API, and workflows carry the contract through Ironclad's signature policies. That plausibly covers sending one templated document to many counterparties. However, the evidence never says each launch delivers the same document to many signers, and it shows only an API path, not a legal-ops UI flow. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-send-for-signature to many recipients, a no-code/UI bulk-send option for legal-ops users, per-recipient tracking details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can bulk-send the same document to many recipients at once
